[[Vokur's Chakram]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Vokur Grimshackles]], a [[boss]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]]

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:Halves casting time of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Jeweled Chakram (metal)]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Inspiration Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Jeweled Chalice]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Swiftness]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
* The [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], and [[Spawning Power]] versions of [[Droknar's Focus]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they require the [[attribute]] associated with the version.
* [[The People's Resolve]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires Divine Favor, Soul Reaping, Fast Casting, Energy Storage, or Spawning Power.
